bedWars.name: Bed Wars
bedWars.description: Bed Wars is a team game where the goal is to destroy the other teams' beds while protecting your own. Collect resources, upgrade your equipment, and work as a team to dominate the game. Strategy, speed, and coordination are the keys to victory!

tntRun.name: TNT Run
tntRun.description: TNT Run is a running and survival game where players must run on blocks that disappear. The last player not to fall into the void wins the game. Agility and speed are essential to survive in this intense game!

launch.title: Official Launch of Minitale!
content: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of Minitale! Our Hytale server is now open with two exciting mini-games: Bed Wars and TNT Run.
Join us now to discover these games and become part of our growing community. Don't forget to join our Discord to stay informed about the latest news.
launch.author: By the Minitale team

tntRun.title: New Mini-Game: TNT Run
content: We are pleased to announce the addition of TNT Run to our collection of mini-games! This running and survival game will challenge you to stay alive as blocks disappear beneath your feet.
Game Features:
Up to 8 players simultaneously
Fast and intense matches
Variety of maps for more fun
tntRun.author: By the Minitale team

bedWars.title: Bed Wars is now available!
content: Bed Wars is now available on Minitale! This strategic team game will allow you to test your collaboration and combat skills.
How to play:
Join a game with your friends or random players
Collect resources to upgrade your equipment
Destroy the enemy teams' beds
Protect your own bed at all costs

about.title: About Minitale
about.subtitle: Discover our philosophy, our team, and our commitment to the community

whoWeAre.title: Who are we?
content: Minitale is a Hytale server dedicated to mini-games, created by a team of gaming enthusiasts.
Our goal is simple: to provide a smooth, fun, and fair gaming experience for all our players.
Whether you're a casual player or a hardcore competitor, you'll find your place on Minitale.
We believe that mini-games like Bed Wars and TNT Run are more than just entertainment: they are opportunities to meet new people, develop strategies, and have fun together.

transparency.title: Transparency: This site was created with AI assistance
content: We want to be completely transparent with our community. The website you are browsing was designed and developed with the help of Vibe Code, an AI agent developed by Mistral AI.
This allowed us to save time in creating a modern, responsive interface optimized for search engines.
However, what truly matters to us is the server itself. The Minitale Hytale server and all its plugins were developed by hand, with care and passion, by our team.
Every line of code for the mini-games, every gameplay mechanism, every server feature was thought out, tested, and perfected by humans to provide the best possible experience.
We use AI as a tool to help us with technical or creative tasks that are not at the core of our passion: creating a quality server for our community.

approach.title: Our Approach
items: Fairness: All players have equal chances to win.
Stability: A server optimized to avoid lags and bugs.
Community: A warm and welcoming atmosphere for everyone.
Innovation: We regularly add new mini-games and features.
